messages:
Sonal: Morning team — launching Polaris dedicated capacity next week. Need final thumbs for: committed quota, autoscale knobs, and the load-test windows. Can we lock these by EOD so CS can confirm with the customer? :calendar:
Diego: Legal approved 10 GPUs, but finance flagged the overage rate. We should align quota with billed commit; suggest set hard quota at 2000 rps and allow burst to 2600 under a temporary soft cap that triggers billing review.
Priya: Customer stated baseline 700 rps, peak 1600 rps in SLAs. Diego's 2000 seems safe. Soft cap and billing notification makes sense. Also recommend we set per-route quotas: chat vs embeddings, since embeddings are more expensive.
Sonal: Good call on per-route. Diego — can you add route breakdown to the infra ticket?
Diego: On it. For autoscale: propose policy: scale when model_util > 65% for 45s, add 1 GPU; scale down after 4m idle. Also keep a manual ceiling at 14 GPUs. If ceiling reached, trigger fallback to quantized-llm-v2 and alert oncall.
Priya: +1. Also add a temporary auto-throttle to client SDK (client-side 429s) to reduce retry storms during cutover. We'll coordinate with Customer-Eng for SDK flags.
Customer-Eng: We can surface SDK throttling flags. We'll need the exact 429 window and backoff settings to implement.
Sonal: For load tests, suggest a three-step plan: smoke (15m at 40% baseline), scale test (45m ramp to 110% peak), and soak (90m steady at 100% peak). Prefer Thu 01:00 PT for smoke/scale and Fri 23:00 PT for soak. Ops window available both slots?
Priya: Thu 01:00 collides with their product release. Can we shift smoke/scale to Wed 03:00 PT? Fri 23:00 for soak works.
Diego: Wed 03:00 PT SGTM. I'll prepare worker clusters in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for cross-region validation.
opsbot: Load job preview:
- target: polaris.customer.internal
- profile: multi-tenant-conversational
- workers: 8 (us-west-2 x5, eu-west-1 x3)
- estimated tokens: 12.4M per run
- dry-run: recommended
Sonal: Priya — please collect 100 golden prompts (mix of short, long, and context-heavy). We'll run them against the canary and the quantized fallback to compute quality drift. Threshold: rollback if >10% golden mismatch or user-facing latency P95 > 400ms for >3m.
Priya: I'll ask the customer for the prompt set and an annotated baseline. ETA end of day.
Diego: I'll create infra ticket: include quotas (2000 rps soft cap 2600 burst), per-route splits (chat: 80%, embeddings: 20%), autoscale rules, ceiling 14 GPUs, fallback model, alarms (model_util_p95, infra_latency_p95, error_rate_5xx, kv_cache_hit). Will link runbook.
Sonal: Need ownerships: Priya owns prompt set & customer comms; Diego owns infra ticket & alarms; Sonal owns traffic shift plan and quality gate; opsbot will run the load jobs.
Priya: Also suggest a gradual traffic ramp: 5% -> 15% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m hold at each step for the first hour, then larger increments pending green checks.
Diego: Add automation gates: infra health, perf traces, kv-hit ratio > 60%, and no sustained 5xx > 0.5%. If any fail, automated rollback to 0% traffic.
Sonal: Final checklist before we close:
- Priya: customer golden prompts + availability confirm (EOD)
- Diego: infra ticket + worker list + dry-run scheduled (EOD)
- Sonal: traffic-shift doc + rollback playbook (EOD)
- Customer-Eng: confirm SDK throttle flags (tomorrow)
_meta: generated slack thread about dedicated capacity bring-up coordination, quotas, autoscale, load tests
